name: SF1 - Search-Profile Generator
description: SF1 Search-Profile Generator. Input: business_context (object). Output: {success, search_profile_id, version, status, target_summary} or {success:false, error}. Stores validated profile+rubric in Supabase search_profiles as draft.

parameters.content: SF1 - Search-Profile Generator. Input: business_context (object). Turns a free-form business context into a versioned search profile + scoring rubric (SF1-SPEC contract), validates it deterministically, and stores it in Supabase Postgres search_profiles as status=draft for human approval. Returns { success, search_profile_id, version, status, target_summary } or { success:false, error }. NO discovery runs here.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO search_profiles (business_context, profile, rubric, status) VALUES ($1::jsonb, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, 'draft') RETURNING id, version, status
